_comment: THE one declaration of every setting the remote environment may set.
'env' is the variable the R drivers actually read; 'name' is the config field.
model       changes WHAT IS ESTIMATED. Two runs differing in a model knob are not comparable,
and the defaults here are the VALIDATED standard -- the evidence for each lives in
docs/sampler_model_specification.md. Deviating is legitimate; doing so unknowingly
is not, so the run log and manifest flag every model knob set away from standard.
operational changes where things go, how long they run, how many cores. Never affects results.

'tasks' is which task FAMILY a knob reaches: nested | flat | project | count. It is not cosmetic -- a nested-only knob offered on a project task is a control that does nothing, and a control that does nothing is indistinguishable from one that is broken.

'blank' is the value that MEANS UNSET for this knob. The routine form marks every declared property required and refuses an empty string, so a knob that is legitimately optional needs a sentinel the form can hold. entrypoint.sh does not export a knob sitting on its blank value, so the driver falls back to its own default exactly as if nothing had been set.

The sentinel is 'auto', NOT 0. NBURN=0 is a REAL value -- a resumed chain is already burnt in, so burning again discards good draws -- and a sentinel of 0 made it inexpressible. A sentinel must be a value the knob can never legitimately take.

knobs.name: NITER
knobs.desc: Total MCMC sweeps.
knobs.label: Iterations (sweeps)

knobs.name: NBURN
knobs.desc: Burn-in sweeps; must be < NITER. Empty keeps the driver default.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)
knobs.label: Burn-in sweeps

knobs.name: THIN
knobs.desc: Store every k-th retained draw.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)
knobs.label: Thinning

knobs.name: N_CHAINS
knobs.desc: Chains fitted in parallel; Rhat needs at least 2.
knobs.label: Chains

knobs.name: SUBSAMPLE
knobs.desc: 0 = every pixel; otherwise cap the pixel count.
knobs.label: Pixel subsample

knobs.name: CLASSIFICATION
knobs.desc: Class column(s) the model predicts -- decides what the outcome IS.
knobs.label: Classification

knobs.name: RE_GROUP
knobs.desc: Grouping the random effects are keyed on.
knobs.label: RE grouping

knobs.name: RE_VARS
knobs.desc: Covariates carrying a random effect. Empty = intercept only (the standard; measured to converge better than random slopes). 'all' = every linear covariate; or a comma-separated list.  (default = leave it to the driver's own default)
knobs.label: RE covariates

knobs.name: RE_BLOCK
knobs.desc: Nested-path RE block. intercept is the documented standard.
knobs.label: RE block

knobs.name: VARIANT
knobs.desc: factorized = independent nests; iv = inclusive-value coupling.
knobs.label: Nested variant

knobs.name: SYMMETRIC_HS
knobs.desc: Symmetric (zero-sum) horseshoe. TRUE is the standard; the job verifies the sampler carries the fix before fitting.
knobs.label: Symmetric horseshoe

knobs.name: USE_BART
knobs.desc: Terrain (and whatever BART_COLS names) enters as a tree ensemble instead of linear terms. FLAT PATH ONLY -- nested_cut has no BART support.
knobs.label: BART

knobs.name: BART_COLS
knobs.desc: Which covariates BART takes. Named blocks, combinable with '+': topo, climate, soil, socio, yield (e.g. 'topo' or 'topo+climate'). Empty = every non-focal column; or give an explicit comma-separated column list. Terrain needs ADD_COORDS=TRUE to include lon/lat.
knobs.label: BART covariate blocks

knobs.name: NTREES_BART
knobs.desc: Trees per class in the ensemble.
knobs.label: BART trees

knobs.name: BART_K_PREV
knobs.desc: Prevalence-scaled leaf shrinkage. Measured super-additive with symmetric BART (+75.4 held-out together vs +38.4 symmetric alone); FALSE restores flat k.
knobs.label: BART prevalence-scaled shrinkage

knobs.name: ADD_COORDS
knobs.desc: Add lon/lat as design columns. REQUIRED for BART_COLS=topo to cover coordinates -- without it 'topo' silently resolves to the 4 terrain columns.
knobs.label: Add lon/lat covariates

knobs.name: COORD_TYPE
knobs.desc: lonlat = EPSG:4326 degrees (readable); laea = native EPSG:3035 metres.
knobs.label: Coordinate type

knobs.name: MUNDLAK
knobs.desc: Group-mean predictors for the RE prior mean. An interpretation fix (removes FE-RE correlation), not an accuracy one.
knobs.label: Mundlak group means

knobs.name: PROMOTE_NATURAL_OTHER
knobs.desc: Move Natural_other out of the non-choosable residual.
knobs.label: Promote Natural_other

knobs.name: N_CORES
knobs.desc: Worker processes. Empty follows N_CHAINS; more cores than chains does not help.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)
knobs.label: Cores

knobs.name: M
knobs.desc: Multiple-imputation draws of the inclusive value. Only reaches the model when VARIANT=iv; with factorized nests there is no inclusive value to impute.
knobs.label: Imputations (M)

knobs.name: BM_NITER
knobs.desc: Sweeps for a project fit. Empty falls back to NITER, then to the project script's own 5000.  ('auto' = leave it to the driver's own default)
knobs.label: Project fit iterations

knobs.name: PIXEL_RES
knobs.desc: Grid resolution in km. 10 km is ~48-64k pixels over the EU, 5 km ~180k -- roughly four times the data and the runtime.
knobs.label: Grid resolution (km)

knobs.name: PIXEL_INTERSECT
knobs.desc: Split each grid cell where it crosses this boundary, so a cell spanning two regions becomes two observations. NULL = native grid cells, no split. Changes the UNIT OF OBSERVATION, not just the labelling.
knobs.label: Cell intersection

knobs.name: BATCH_DIR
knobs.label: Posterior batch directory
knobs.desc: The saved_model_outputs/<label>/ directory holding the fit's posterior batches. 'auto' takes the newest one under output/saved_model_outputs.

knobs.name: TESTFRAC
knobs.label: Held-out fraction
knobs.desc: Fraction of pixels held out and scored. This is the measurement the gate exists for: both arms are scored on the SAME held-out set.

knobs.name: SPLIT
knobs.label: Held-out split
knobs.desc: random = scattered pixels; country = whole countries held out. Random is ~20x more optimistic, because a country RE carries most of the skill and a random split never tests an unseen region.

knobs.name: ARMS
knobs.label: Arms to fit
knobs.desc: Which arms to fit, comma separated. Both is the point; one arm alone tells you nothing, since the comparison IS the result. Resumable, so a killed run keeps the arm it finished.
